about: The 12 November 2026 full read found categories that were near twins of an older category in the same pack: four or five of the same answers, often the very same facts. In each pair the older category stays as it was and the twin below gets new clues on the same theme with different answers, so a player never meets the same board twice. Values and Daily Double flags stay on their rows. `rows` lists all five clues of the category after the rewrite, easiest first; a row marked keep is the old clue that was not a repeat. `singles` replace one clue that told the same fact as a clue elsewhere. Apply with: node scripts/apply-category-rewrites.cjs packs-src/twin-rewrites-2026-11-12.json
